title: An integrated analysis of Maglemose bone points reframes the Early Mesolithic of Southern Scandinavia
version: Scientific Reports 10, article 17244; full PMC HTML, CC BY 4.0
lineage: Primary archaeological analysis supplies an earlier barbed-point comparison; it does not establish how every point was mounted or that these were ancestral to the later examples.

passages.note: Introduction and results: directly dated earlier barbed bone-point assemblages from southern Scandinavia.
